verdict.rationale: The evidence shows plan approval, agent-to-agent shot review, activity logs, and pause/resume of jobs. None of these is versioning, review, or rollback of the user's automations, so they are adjacent features rather than this capability. Styles being plain Markdown files might let a user track them in their own version control, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
